body: The spec is methodologically careful — nested CV with feature selection inside the training fold, CLR transformation, and BH correction are all real improvements over the naive plan. But there are two internal inconsistencies worth flagging. First, the feature-selection leakage protection is undermined by the correlation analysis itself: FR-004/FR-005 run on the full dataset, and any taxa reported as 'significantly correlated' from that whole-cohort screen have already seen the outcome data, so the published correlation results and the predictive model cannot be treated as independent lines of evidence. Second, US-2's independent test claims validation on 'a synthetic dataset with known correlations,' but no such synthetic data generator is specified anywhere in the requirements or acceptance scenarios — the test is asserted but not established. Third, the responder definition is left disjunctive ('seroconversion (≥4-fold rise in titer) or an absolute titer threshold') with no rule for which is primary, and with N ≥ 50 split into high/low classes, per-fold training sets may be small enough that the >60% accuracy target (SC-003) is within noise of a majority-class baseline — no baseline-accuracy comparison is required. Finally, the branch name '001-gene-regulation' appears to be a leftover from an unrelated project.
